verdict.rationale: Greenhouse is a SaaS recruiting platform, and whether it can be self-hosted is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a self-hosted, on-premises or downloadable deployment of the core product. The APIs, webhooks, custom job boards and the 'Developer sandbox & sync' plan feature are integration and testing capabilities on the hosted service, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
